paragraphs.text: Bidirectional knowledge bridge between DeepSeek Harness and Obsidian Vault — FTS5 search, draft writ
Bidirectional knowledge bridge between DeepSeek Harness (DSH) and Obsidian Vault.
Gives DSH agents direct read/write access to your Obsidian Vault. The agent can search notes via SQL
ite FTS5 full-text search, read full content by path or wiki-link, write draft notes back to the vau
lt, and create bidirectional links between DSH sessions and notes.
Unlike existing one-way export tools or MCP-based bridges, this plugin runs natively inside the DSH
Cordis framework — no external server, no need for Obsidian to be running.
